def transform(grid):
    # Reduce each separator-delimited tile by marking the location of its
    # sparse foreground color. Tile dimensions and separators vary by instance.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if len({r[j] for r in grid})==1]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    from collections import Counter
    freq=Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i not in rs and j not in cs)
    mark=min(freq,key=freq.get); bg=max(freq,key=freq.get)
    return [[bg if sum(grid[i][j]==mark for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(x+1,y))==1 else 1 for x,y in zip(cb,cb[1:])] for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:])]
